life_summary: Ulisses Soares was born on October 2, 1958, in São Paulo, Brazil. He grew up in South America during a period of significant social and economic change and pursued education that prepared him for business and Church leadership roles. Before his full-time Church appointment, Soares established a successful business career in Brazil while maintaining deep involvement in his local congregation. In October 1982, he married Rosana Fernandes Morgado at the São Paulo Brazil Temple, and together they raised three children. His background as a Brazilian business leader brought practical experience in organizational management and cross-cultural communication to his subsequent Church responsibilities.
church_summary: Soares served as a missionary in the Brazil Rio de Janeiro Mission beginning in early 1978, where he developed deep roots in Brazilian culture and the Church's presence in South America. He later served as president of the Portugal Porto Mission from 2000 to 2003, extending his international leadership experience to Europe. He was called to the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles in 2005. His ministry has centered on the principle that the gospel is about people rather than programs, emphasizing relational and human-centered ministry. He dedicated the Fortaleza Brazil Temple in June 2019 and the Arequipa Peru Temple in December 2019, and participated in multiple other temple dedications across the Americas and Europe.

mission.location: Brazil Rio de Janeiro; Portugal Porto (mission president 2000–2003)
